title: Senior Data engineer
jobDescription: Job Title: Senior Data Engineer with data analytic skills Department: Lenovo Customer Experience Company Overview: Lenovo is the fastest growing technology company on the planet, with growth outpacing our competition quarter after quarter and we’re growing! Lenovo’s fundamental belief is that life rewards those who Never Stand Still. Every day, every employee at Lenovo is focused on moving forward, rejecting traditional limits, and always seeking a better way. We are looking for the person who challenges the ordinary and seeks to innovate in learning, while also balancing execution. Position Overview: Lenovo’s Customer Experience team is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join its Bangalore, India-based team. We're looking for a skilled and experienced self-starter to work in our CX department as a Data Engineer. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be involved in data Lakehouse development including requirements gathering, database modeling, ETL job design & development, and dashboard/report development activities. You will frequently conduct data analysis, ingest data from various internal and external sources, write advanced database queries, and optimize data storage needed by business and executive operations. You will enable daily business activities by providing the foundation for all federated querying and analysis produced by the BI and Data Science teams. Key Responsibilities As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be involved in data Lakehouse development including requirements gathering, database modeling, ETL job design & development, and dashboard/report development activities. You will be working with the Customer Experience team to build and enhance a cloud-based warehouse of operational data to drive analytics. You will be responsible for developing ETL/data pipelines using Talend, SQL, and Python, and ingesting data from various external sources into large MPP data warehouses such as Azure Synapse, Hive, Snowflake, or similar platforms. You will frequently conduct data analysis, ingest data from various internal and external sources, write advanced SQL queries, and optimize data storage needed by business and executive operations. You will partner with business stakeholders to analyze operational data, investigate trends, answer ad hoc business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making. You will perform exploratory data analysis, validate data quality, identify anomalies, reconcile data across multiple sources, and translate business requirements into SQL-based analyses and actionable insights. You will develop complex SQL queries to extract, profile, reconcile, and analyze large datasets, helping stakeholders understand business performance, customer behavior, operational metrics, and data quality issues. You will enable daily business activities by providing the foundation for all federated querying and analysis produced by the BI and Data Science teams. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, BI Developers, and Data Scientists to ensure data is accurate, reliable, and optimized for reporting, advanced analytics, and machine learning initiatives. You will have the opportunity to work with modern data stack components and continuously grow by learning new tools and technologies in a collaborative, data-driven environment. Position Requirements Basic Qualifications Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Science. Minimum 5 years of experience in ETL development and coding, including validation of complex data mappings. Hands-on experience with ETL Tool Talend (minimum 5 years). Proficient in SQL with at least 8 years of experience developing complex SQL queries for data validation, troubleshooting, and business analysis. Experience in Python for data processing and transformation tasks. Strong experience with data warehouse databases such as Azure Synapse, Hive, Snowflake, SQL Server, or Redshift. Experience and knowledge in ingesting data from various external sources is a must-have. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into meaningful business insights. Experience performing data profiling, data quality analysis, data reconciliation, and root cause analysis using SQL. Experience working with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements and support data-driven decision-making. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Experience working with cloud-based data platforms. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to Databricks for big data processing and orchestration. Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Familiarity with Agile Scrum development methodologies. Experience working in or exposure to Data Science, Machine Learning, or Generative AI-based projects.

title: Advisory Solution Architect
jobDescription: Role Brief We are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Solution Architect to drive business growth and solution development across Managed Services, Digital Workplace Services, Infrastructure Management, NOC Services, System Integration, and Device-as-a-Service (Daa S) offerings. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of business development, solutioning, managed services, and technical consulting experience, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders, develop winning service strategies, and support large enterprise customers globally. This role requires a strategic thinker with proven experience in designing and positioning managed service solutions, negotiating complex contracts, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver business outcomes. The successful candidate will play a critical role in expanding customer relationships, driving revenue growth, and enhancing Lenovo's services portfolio. Key Responsibilities Develop and position innovative Managed Services solutions aligned with customer business objectives. Drive business development activities, including customer engagement, opportunity qualification, and solution strategy. Lead Statement of Work (SOW) creation, proposal development, contract discussions, and solution presentations. Partner with sales, delivery, technical, and partner teams to create scalable service offerings. Design solutions across Digital Workplace Services, Infrastructure Management, NOC Services, System Integration, and Daa S environments. Support large enterprise and global accounts by aligning service capabilities with customer transformation initiatives. Conduct commercial assessments, pricing reviews, and contract negotiations to ensure profitable business outcomes. Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders across multiple organizational levels. Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to strengthen service offerings and competitive positioning. Contribute to the development of go-to-market strategies for new services and technology solutions. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Managed Services, Professional Services, Business Development, Project Management, or Solution Development. Experience in developing and managing Statements of Work (SOWs) and complex service solutions. Strong understanding of Managed Services, Digital Workplace Services, Infrastructure Services, System Integration, and Daa S offerings. Proven track record of building and delivering successful managed service solutions for enterprise customers. Experience in IT Services Operations or Service Delivery environments. Strategic mindset with strong business acumen and analytical decision-making skills. Excellent contract negotiation, stakeholder management, and partner engagement abilities. Outstanding verbal and written communication, presentation, and customer-facing skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver against deadlines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Power Point, Excel) and Microsoft Dynamics. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment. Bachelor's Degree or equivalent professional experience. Fluent in English. Willingness to travel up to 20%. Preferred Qualifications MBA, MCA, BE, or other advanced technical/business degree. Technical certifications in Azure, AWS, AI, Infrastructure Technologies, or Service Now. Experience selling or positioning consumption-based services, including Saa S, Daa S, Cloud Services, or Managed Services. Experience supporting Global Enterprise Accounts with multiple stakeholder groups and complex buying environments. Strong understanding of cloud transformation, workplace modernization, and infrastructure outsourcing services. Key Competencies Solution Development & Consulting Managed Services & Digital Workplace Services Business Development & Revenue Growth Enterprise Client Engagement Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Strategic Planning & Execution Infrastructure & Cloud Services Stakeholder & Partner Management Executive Presentation Skills Cross-Functional Leadership

title: IT Service Quality & Audit Lead
jobDescription: Role Summary The IT Service Quality & Audit Lead is responsible for driving service quality, audit governance, and continuous improvement across IT Service Desk operations. This role leads quality audits across multiple support channels, identifies systemic gaps, and partners closely with service delivery leaders to improve customer experience, process compliance, and operational outcomes. The role also leads and mentors a team of Quality Analysts. Key Responsibilities Lead and govern quality audits across Voice, Email, Chat, and ITSM tickets (Incidents, Changes, Problems), ensuring adherence to ITIL processes, SLAs, KPIs, and service standards. Review audit results to identify compliance gaps, defect trends, and process inefficiencies, and ensure consistent evaluation standards across auditors. Perform root cause analysis on recurring quality issues and drive corrective actions, process improvements, and training interventions. Own the service desk quality training framework and ensure learning plans are aligned to audit findings and performance gaps. Partner with Service Delivery and Operations leaders to align quality expectations, priorities, and improvement outcomes. Act as the quality single point of contact (SPOC) for internal stakeholders and customers, presenting insights in a clear, business‑focused manner. Lead, coach, and develop a team of Quality Analysts to ensure timely audits, reporting, and follow‑through on improvement actions. Deliver regular quality dashboards and reports covering audit scores, SLA adherence, defect trends, and training effectiveness to enable data‑driven decisions. Skills & Experience Must‑Have 4–8 years of experience in IT Service Delivery, Process Quality, or IT Operations Quality Assurance. Proven experience leading a team of Quality Analysts or Process Auditors. Strong understanding of ITIL‑based service desk operations and IT Service Management (ITSM). Hands‑on experience with voice and ticket quality audits, process compliance, and governance. Experience driving training programs, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. ITIL v3 Intermediate or ITIL 4 certification. Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Good‑to‑Have Exposure to ISO 9001 or similar quality frameworks. Familiarity with quality tools such as Pareto analysis, RCA, control charts, or FMEA. Six Sigma or Lean exposure. Experience working in infrastructure or IT support environments.
